newsitem.title: USA: UAL Corp CEO 1996 salary at $657,000.
newsitem.headline: UAL Corp CEO 1996 salary at $657,000.

text.p: Gerald Greenwald, chairman and chief executive officer of UAL Corp was paid a salary of $657,184 for 1996 and received a $725,000 bonus, according to a regulatory filing Monday.
UAL paid the value of the bonus to Greenwald, 61, in common stock instead of cash, it said in a proxy filed with the Securities and Exchange Commision.

UAL also granted Greenwald a stock option covering 132,000 shares of stock, exercisable in four equal annual installments starting April 24, 1997, one year from the date of the grant, the filing said.
The strike price for these stock options is $53.47 a share for all options that expire April 23, 2006, UAL said.
